method: Unchanged current LPX complete files and ROM player. 16 MHz/8 kHz, original Timer0/Timer1, FIFO32/prefill24, Q7 gain128, assembly ISR, explicit supported arithmetic. Only existing unroll/function-tuning selectors change. No physical board.
decision: No candidate is selected. Tiny unroll variants are binary-identical no-ops in these specialized current players; Mega function tuning7 is larger and slower. No final corpus matrix is warranted.
source_sample_weighting: Foreground CPU totals / corresponding decode_calls or producer_calls, never PWM writes including underrun silence.
scope: Eight complete active-IRQ ASM pilots only, two unchanged audio streams; no new C/ASM arithmetic implementation and no claim for untested settings or workloads.
